framing.lineOfInquiry: Sandeep Gupta (P00306) may have been involved in the incident recorded in CASE030
framing.alternate: Sandeep Gupta (P00306) was not involved — the evidence has an innocent explanation
framing.note: KRONOS starts from the presumption of innocence. The line of inquiry and the alternates are tested against the same records; neither is a finding, and the strengths are not probabilities.

alternateHypotheses.title: Was elsewhere at the time (alibi)
alternateHypotheses.statement: Sandeep Gupta was somewhere else when the incident happened.
alternateHypotheses.label: Moderate

evidence.text: Recorded at an unnamed place, 28.7 km from the scene, 25 min before the incident — the scene was reachable by road in that time, so this is only a partial alibi
Recorded at Sector 56 Residential, Gurugram, 28.5 km from the scene, 72 min after the incident — the scene was reachable by road in that time, so this is only a partial alibi

alternateHypotheses.test: Verify the alibi record independently (CCTV, witnesses or receipts at that place and time) and check whether the device could have been carried by someone else.

alternateHypotheses.title: Named or given a role in error
alternateHypotheses.statement: Sandeep Gupta was named in the FIR, or assigned a role, without an independent basis.
alternateHypotheses.label: Weak
alternateHypotheses.test: Re-examine the FIR and statements; record the person's statement and the informant's basis for naming them.

alternateHypotheses.title: The contact was routine, not coordination
alternateHypotheses.statement: Sandeep Gupta's calls and messages reflect a long-standing relationship (family, work, business), not planning of the incident.
alternateHypotheses.label: Weak

evidence.text: In contact with Gaurav Chauhan since 2025-04-06, 29 days before the incident (13 calls, 18 messages) — a long-standing relationship
In contact with Manoj Bansal since 2025-04-13, 22 days before the incident (7 calls, 2 messages) — a long-standing relationship

alternateHypotheses.test: Examine message content and the timing of contact relative to the incident; establish the relationship.

alternatesConsideredNotSupported.title: Was near the scene for a routine reason
Someone else used the phone or handset
The money has a legitimate explanation
